summary: AVITA Medical filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of a warrant to Perceptive Credit Holdings V, LP following stockholder approval at the 2026 annual meeting. The warrant covers up to 500,000 shares (plus 150,000 if an additional $10M commitment is drawn) at $3.4019 per share, granted under the existing credit agreement. This is a routine equity-linked issuance tied to a prior credit facility, not a standalone special situation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present. The filing merely satisfies disclosure requirements for a material definitive agreement amendment.
